content.bodyCopyTextCta: Enhance your shopping experience with benefits reserved exclusively for guests of our partners. Earn miles or loyalty points, enjoy complimentary services, additional savings and special access to Village events through a tailored reward programme.
content.headline: A member of theirs, a friend of ours

childMarkdownRemark.html: These benefits are offered as part of programmes run by third-party partners. While we help connect you to these opportunities, each programme is managed by the partner directly and comes with its own terms and conditions.

Each partner sets the rules for their own programme – including eligibility, how to claim, and what’s included/excluded. It is your responsibility to read, understand and comply with the partner’s terms before claiming any benefit.
Key information is highlighted on the relevant partner pages on our website, but full terms will be available directly from the partner. Our summaries are for guidance only.
As these benefits are run by third parties, they may be changed or withdrawn without notice. We do not guarantee availability and are not liable for changes made by a partner.
If you’re unsure who’s offering a benefit or have questions about eligibility or redemption, we’ll do our best to guide you – but for any issues, the partner is your main point of contact.
